annotations.title: Extract companies from a partner or member directory

description: Turn a vendor partner directory or a trade body member list into one company row per listing. Give directory_url or directory_urls (up to 20). Reads directories built on PartnerPage (for example https://www.clay.com/en/experts or the Zapier partner directory) through PartnerPage's public listing API, the Shopify Partner Directory (any https://www.shopify.com/partners/directory/... page), and member lists that link to one profile page per member. Each row: listing_name, company_domain, website, listing_url, tier, tags, location, rating, review_count, partner_since, and the email and phone the directory itself publishes. robots.txt is checked before every request. A directory that cannot be read (it builds its list in the browser) returns one free row with row_status unsupported. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per company row.

dedupe_domains.description: Return a company listed more than once only once; skipped repeats are free. Default true.

include_details.description: PartnerPage directories: true adds tags, location, and the listed email with one more request per listing. Default true.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before any row that would take its charges over this amount.

max_listings.description: Listings per directory, 1 to 5000. Each company row is billed. Default 100.

max_pages.description: Shopify and member list directories: listing pages to read, 1 to 100. Default 10.

name: extract_directory_companies
title: Extract companies from a partner or member directory
